title: MV Difficulty Option when choosing New Game

posts.author: Solarae
posts.body:
I’m trying to set up a difficulty select thing for RPG Maker MV using Yanfly’s Difficulty Slider plugin.
When you hit
New Game
, I want a little menu to pop up first where you pick difficulty, like:
Choose your difficulty:
Story – 60%
Easy – 80%
Normal – 100%
Hard – 120%+
Then once you pick one, it just starts the game normally with that difficulty already applied.
I’m trying to do this as a plugin instead of eventing, since it feels like it should be cleaner that way, but I’m not fully sure how to make it properly.
I am new to .js, so I am not sure how to even make one for this, or if there is one out there that works with Yanfly that I missed. In my game, with the Yanfly plugin, you can choose it from the options menu, but I also want the player to choose it when starting a new game, so they don't have to go into options first or get told to change it in the options from an NPC.
